content:
The **Resolute Veteran** is a heavy gun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

It was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Stake your claim on the Wasteland" in Survival mode from May 7 to May 13, 2019.
